separation: train: dev split, 4 mechanism families, difficulty 1-3, novelty 0-2. protected_test: validation split, difficulty 4 for every family plus two mechanism families (invoice_dispute, compound) never used in training. adversarial: difficulty 5, novelty 3-5 (authority revocation, message lag).
analysis: Task success = chosen strategy is among those tied for the best independently measured value. Paired by scenario; 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples. Verdicts: PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE. A constant always-risk_averse policy is reported beside every learned arm.
